Which statement describes the relationship between mass and weight?
A
Mass is the effect of a gravitational field on a weight.
B
Mass is the effect of a magnetic field on a weight.
C
Weight is the effect of a gravitational field on a mass.
D
Weight is the effect of a magnetic field on a mass.

options.label: A
options.text: Mass is the effect of a gravitational field on a weight.

options.label: B

options.label: C
